column1: # Complete the startup call, open OPTIONS, select SAVE, then close the authored
# ten-slot save list through its CANCEL row.
# Exercise the executable keyboard handlers while SAVE owns input. Down and Up
# move the editable slot, printable bytes reach the editor, and P remains a text
# byte without toggling pause while save_request_active is set.
# Outside SAVE, the same P handler toggles pause in both directions.
# Reopen OPTIONS and exercise the sibling LOAD owner through the same authored
# list transition and CANCEL row. Enter still publishes carriage return, but the
# original LOAD path does not treat it as a row selection.
